title: One Card, One Slot
description: Dragging a shipment's card to a new time slot on the board should move it, not clone it — a shipment must never hold two simultaneous assignments.
successCondition: Book a shipment and create an assignment for it with PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId. Note the returned assignment.id. Call PUT /api/fleet/assignments/:shipmentId again for the same shipmentId with a different vehicleId/driverId/time window. The response's assignment.id is identical to the first call's id (proving it was updated, not duplicated), and GET /api/fleet/assignments contains exactly one assignment for that shipmentId with the second call's updated vehicleId/driverId/times.
hints: The upsert is keyed by shipmentId per docs/api/fleet.md — the shipment id is the path param, and Prisma's upsert on a unique shipmentId is what guarantees a single row.
Pick a genuinely different vehicleId and driverId for the second call (not identical values) so you can clearly confirm the row's contents actually changed, not just its existence.
